mapper.select: SELECT w.id, w.name, w.slug, w.created_at, w.updated_at FROM workspace w JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.workspace_id = w.id WHERE wm.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY w.id
SELECT w.id, w.name, w.slug, wm.role FROM workspace w JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.workspace_id = w.id WHERE wm.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY w.name, w.id
SELECT id, name, slug, created_at, updated_at FROM workspace WHERE slug = 'default' LIMIT 1
SELECT role FROM workspace_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT last_active_workspace_id FROM app_user WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET last_active_workspace_id = #{workspaceId} WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.email, u.password_hash, u.timezone, u.last_login_at, u.profile_picture_url, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM app_user u JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.user_id = u.id WHERE wm.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY u.display_name, u.id

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name AS displayName, u.email, wm.role FROM app_user u JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.user_id = u.id WHERE wm.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY FIELD(wm.role, 'owner', 'admin', 'member'), u.display_name, u.id

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name AS displayName, u.email, wm.role FROM app_user u JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.user_id = u.id WHERE wm.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND wm.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND role = 'owner'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM workspace_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET assigned_to_id = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND assigned_to_id = #{userId}
UPDATE deal SET owner_id = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND owner_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_member (workspace_id, user_id, role) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{userId}, #{role})
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_member SET role = #{role} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId}
